title: Garden Guardian
note: Subject v2.0. Each script's output is compared line by line to the subject example (blank lines included). The output is an example: other wording is a warning, but the values (inputs, numbers, which exception class is caught, in order) must match. The functions are imported and called directly (return value + raised exception), and the source is checked: authorized builtins (super() accepted in ex3 / ex4), no import, type hints, flake8, mypy (ex2's TypeError is a mypy error on purpose: warning only).

assert err is None, 'operation %d must not raise, got %r' % (n, err)

tests.name: one try: block catches several error types
